description:
Powerful 250W Motor with 3-Level Pedal Assist
Enjoy smooth and efficient support on your everyday rides. The HITWAY BK5SL folding electric bike is powered by a reliable 250W brushless motor, delivering pedal-assisted speeds of 15 / 20 / 25 km/h to suit different riding situations. With the ability to handle inclines of up to 25°, it is ideal for city commuting, daily errands, short trips and relaxed weekend rides.
Compact Folding Design for Easy Commuting & Storage
Built with a high-strength carbon steel frame, the BK5SL offers reliable durability and stability for daily use. The 16 × 2.4-inch tyres provide improved grip, balance and comfort on urban roads. Thanks to its practical foldable frame, you can easily take it on public transport, store it at home or in the office, or place it in the boot of your car. It is a smart choice for compact living and modern urban mobility.
Enhanced Safety with Dual Disc Brakes & E-Brake System
Ride with greater confidence in busy city environments. The HITWAY BK5SL is equipped with front and rear disc brakes plus an intelligent electronic brake system, which cuts motor power immediately when braking for better control and safer stopping. For low-light riding, the bright front light and reflective wheel strips help improve visibility. The StVZO-compliant lighting supports safer everyday riding in European road conditions.
Integrated System with Removable 36V 13Ah Battery
Designed for everyday convenience, the BK5SL uses a clean integrated structure that combines the controller, wiring and battery into a neater, more compact setup. The removable 36V 13Ah battery provides 468Wh capacity and delivers a riding range of approximately 50–100 km, depending on rider weight, road conditions, temperature and assist level. Compared with the standard 8.4Ah version, it offers around 55% more battery capacity. You can charge the battery at home, in the office or wherever convenient, without carrying the whole bike indoors.
Smart Riding with Bluetooth Display & App Control
Enjoy a smarter and more connected riding experience. The upgraded LCD display supports Bluetooth and app control, allowing you to unlock the bike via the app, check ride data, view mileage, adjust settings and control the lights with ease. This makes the BK5SL more than just a compact folding e-bike — it is a smart everyday mobility solution for urban riders across Europe.
